body:
Pass a select with no existing projection to scan.All/One. Reader columns append; they do not replace or ignore existing selected columns. database/sql then rejects a wider result than the Reader's destinations. Put desired fields in the Reader. This replaces the old, incorrect comment that extra columns were selected but never scanned.

Evidence: ds:block?id=reader-projection-3xfnp55v; ds:block?id=reader-flow-xcq2taqt. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Reader projection columns are appended
